Captured Odin end-session trace — instrumented fork, macOS arm64, 2026-10-14
==========================================================================
This trace was captured from a real attached Download-Mode device during the
investigation (see docs/s10plus-heimdall-endsession-investigation.md, incident
section). It is retained because it is the only real packet-level EndSession
trace we have, and it shows the handshake *succeeding* on this host stack.

Binary: build/heimdall-nuxel/out/heimdall-nuxel (v2.2.2-nuxel)
Command shape: heimdall-nuxel flash --BOOT <img> --nuxel-trace-packets ...

[nuxel] send-timeout=3000ms receive-timeout=8000ms reboot-timeout=8000ms empty-transfers=after trace=on
Initialising connection...
Detecting device...
Claiming interface...
Initialising protocol...
Protocol initialisation successful.

Beginning session...
Session begun.

Downloading device's PIT file...
PIT file download successful.

Uploading BOOT
100%
BOOT upload successful

Ending session...
    [nuxel] TX len=1024 type=0x67 hex=67000000000000000000000000000000...   <- EndSession request (request=0)
    [nuxel] RX len=8    type=0x67 hex=6700000000000000                      <- 0x67 acknowledged (attempt 1)
    [nuxel] TX len=1024 type=0x67 hex=67000000010000000000000000000000...   <- reboot request (request=1)
    [nuxel] RX len=8    type=0x67 hex=6700000000000000                      <- 0x67 acknowledged
Verifying the device left Download Mode...
The device is no longer present in Download Mode (rebooted).
Releasing device interface...

[nuxel] NUXEL_SESSION_RESULT=ok_acknowledged
[nuxel] NUXEL_FAILURE_CLASS=none
[nuxel] NUXEL_END_SESSION_ACK_RECEIVED=1
[nuxel] NUXEL_ACK_RESPONSE_TYPE=0x67
[nuxel] NUXEL_ACK_BYTES=8
[nuxel] NUXEL_ACK_ATTEMPTS=1
[nuxel] NUXEL_ACK_ELAPSED_MS=7
[nuxel] NUXEL_LAST_LIBUSB_ERROR=0
[nuxel] NUXEL_REBOOT_ACK_RECEIVED=1
[nuxel] NUXEL_DEVICE_STILL_PRESENT=0
[nuxel] NUXEL_EXIT_CODE=0

Interpretation
--------------
1. The device CAN answer EndSession with the expected 0x67 response, and did so
   on the first attempt in ~7 ms. This falsifies "this S-Boot never acks 0x67"
   as a universal statement.
2. It confirms the EndSession + reboot handshake can complete on macOS/libusb
   while the same class of device produced "Failed to receive session end
   confirmation" on the operator's Linux/Docker stack. That points at a
   host-stack / timing difference (candidate H-C: delayed acknowledgement, or
   the zero-length OUT transfer's 100 ms timeout interacting with the host).
3. It is NOT proof that the flashed image boots. `NuxelExitCode=0` only means the
   session closed and the phone left Download Mode.
